g.text: Streaming | Event-time correction before online delivery
Layer 2 · Reading ID, delivery attempt and publication time remain distinct.
Staged CI path. Flink writes retained output; a separate job publishes online.
Corrected: 15-minute watermark delay; ten-minute tumbling windows; no allowed-lateness extension.
Baseline disables dedup and uses zero watermark delay; it is an intentional comparison.
Cache expiry uses processing-time timers; a durable ledger prevents re-counting after expiry.
SQLite sink/ledger writes are not checkpoint-transactional: no general exactly-once claim.
Native 5,760-window and small CI/Airflow demonstrations are separate bounded runs.
Acknowledged writer replay skips counts/writes/TTL renewal; old windows cannot regress state.
The four stream fields above are independent from the eight rolling prediction inputs.
